scope: New unpublished coffee-table edition; preserve reviewed reading edition and website prose
target_pages: 100–120 if meaningful image material supports it; no filler to reach count
preserve: Twelve chapter narrative order and full reviewed text
85% maximum book image width; original aspect ratios
35% heritage accents; no added decorative scene art
visual_direction: Real people and actions in verified settings
Vary landscape, work, objects, social spaces and portraits
Avoid exoticising people or treating festival dress as daily practice
Retain strong existing interpretive illustrations with honest captions
Use image-caption pairings that add documented visual context, not invented testimony
rights_handling: Record actual reuse terms and unresolved status per image; current scope is unpublished editorial draft, no publication or permission claim. User authorised internet-image sourcing for this draft.
future_replacement: Keep stable image IDs and chapter placements so user photographs can replace selected images later without rewriting the book.
